busy = {
    "Deborah": [],
    "Albert": [("09:00", "10:00"), ("10:30", "12:00"), ("15:00", "16:30")],
}
work_start = 9 * 60
work_end = 17 * 60
duration = 30
latest_end = 11 * 60

def to_min(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def fmt(t):
    return f"{t // 60:02d}:{t % 60:02d}"

def is_free(person, start, end):
    for b in busy[person]:
        bs, be = to_min(b[0]), to_min(b[1])
        if start < be and end > bs:
            return False
    return True

for start in range(work_start, work_end - duration + 1):
    end = start + duration
    ok = True
    for person in busy:
        if not is_free(person, start, end):
            ok = False
            break
        if person == "Albert" and end > latest_end:
            ok = False
            break
    if ok:
        print(["Monday", fmt(start), fmt(end)])
        break
```

```python
def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def fmt(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

WORK_START = to_minutes("09:00")
WORK_END = to_minutes("17:00")
DURATION = 30
MEGAN_AVAILABLE_FROM = to_minutes("10:00")

BUSY = {
    "Kimberly": [
        (to_minutes("10:00"), to_minutes("10:30")),
        (to_minutes("11:00"), to_minutes("12:00")),
        (to_minutes("16:00"), to_minutes("16:30")),
    ],
    "Megan": [],
    "Marie": [
        (to_minutes("10:00"), to_minutes("11:00")),
        (to_minutes("11:30"), to_minutes("15:00")),
        (to_minutes("16:00"), to_minutes("16:30")),
    ],
    "Diana": [
        (to_minutes("09:30"), to_minutes("10:00")),
        (to_minutes("10:30"), to_minutes("14:30")),
        (to_minutes("15:30"), to_minutes("17:00")),
    ],
}

def overlaps(start, end, busy_start, busy_end):
    return start < busy_end and busy_start < end

def is_available(start, end):
    if start < WORK_START or end > WORK_END:
        return False
    for participant in BUSY:
        for busy_start, busy_end in BUSY[participant]:
            if overlaps(start, end, busy_start, busy_end):
                return False
    if start < MEGAN_AVAILABLE_FROM:
        return False
    return True

answer = None
for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END, DURATION):
    end = start + DURATION
    if is_available(start, end):
        answer = ["Monday", fmt(start), fmt(end)]
        break

print(answer)
```

```python
days = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"]

def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def to_hhmm(t):
    return f"{t // 60:02d}:{t % 60:02d}"

work_start = to_minutes("09:00")
work_end = to_minutes("17:00")
duration = 30

schedules = {
    "Julie": {
        "Monday": [],
        "Tuesday": [],
        "Wednesday": [],
        "Thursday": [],
    },
    "Ruth": {
        "Monday": [(to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("17:00"))],
        "Tuesday": [(to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("17:00"))],
        "Wednesday": [(to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("17:00"))],
        "Thursday": [
            (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("11:00")),
            (to_minutes("11:30"), to_minutes("14:30")),
            (to_minutes("15:00"), to_minutes("17:00")),
        ],
    },
}

def is_free(person, day, start, end):
    return not any(
        start < busy_end and end > busy_start
        for busy_start, busy_end in schedules[person][day]
    )

def satisfies_preferences(day, start):
    return not (day == "Thursday" and start < to_minutes("11:30"))

candidates = []
for day in days:
    for start in range(work_start, work_end, duration):
        end = start + duration
        if not satisfies_preferences(day, start):
            continue
        if all(is_free(person, day, start, end) for person in schedules):
            candidates.append((day, start, end))

day, start, end = candidates[0]
print([day, to_hhmm(start), to_hhmm(end)])
```

        if end > cursor:

    if cursor < work_end:

    availability[person] = free

import sys

DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday"]
WORK_START = 9 * 60
WORK_END = 17 * 60

def to_min(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))

    return f"{m // 60:02d}:{m % 60:02d}"

def parse_intervals(items):
    intervals = []
    for item in items:
        start_s, end_s = item.split("-")
        intervals.append((to_min(start_s), to_min(end_s)))
    return intervals

def overlaps(start, end, intervals):
    for bstart, bend in intervals:
        if start < bend and end > bstart:
            return True
    return False

        if not overlaps(start, end, betty) and not overlaps(start, end, megan):
            solution = [day, fmt_min(start), fmt_min(end)]

print(solution)

```python
from datetime import time

def to_minutes(hhmm):
    h, m = map(int, hhmm.split(':'))
    return h*60 + m

def to_hhmm(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

busy = {
    "Jean": {
        "Monday": [],
        "Tuesday": [("11:30", "12:00"), ("16:00", "16:30")],
    },
    "Doris": {
        "Monday": [("09:00", "11:30"), ("12:00", "12:30"), ("13:30", "16:00"), ("16:30", "17:00")],
        "Tuesday": [("09:00", "17:00")],
    },
}

work_start = to_minutes("09:00")
work_end = to_minutes("17:00")
duration = 30

def overlaps(start, end, busy_start, busy_end):
    return start < busy_end and end > busy_start

def is_free(day, start, end):
    for person_schedules in busy.values():
        for bstart, bend in person_schedules[day]:
            if overlaps(start, end, to_minutes(bstart), to_minutes(bend)):
                return False
    return True

def preference_ok(day, start, end):
    if day == "Monday" and start >= to_minutes("14:00"):  # or end >?
        return False
    return True

def solve():
    for day in ["Monday", "Tuesday"]:
        for start in range(work_start, work_end, duration):
            end = start + duration
            if end > work_end:
                continue
            if not is_free(day, start, end):
                continue
            if not preference_ok(day, start, end):
                continue
            print([day, to_hhmm(start), to_hhmm(end)])
            return

solve()
```

def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def fmt(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

def conflicts(start, end, intervals):
    for a, b in intervals:
        bs = to_minutes(a)
        be = to_minutes(b)
        if start < be and end > bs:
            return True
    return False

def main():
    days = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday"]
    schedule = {
        "Nicole": {
            "Monday": [],
            "Tuesday": [("16:00", "16:30")],
            "Wednesday": [("15:00", "15:30")],
            "Thursday": [],
            "Friday": [("12:00", "12:30"), ("15:30", "16:00")],

    work_start = 9 * 60

    for day in days:

            if end > work_end:

            for person in schedule:
                if conflicts(start, end, schedule[person][day]):
                    free = False

            if free:

if __name__ == "__main__":

def to_min(time_str):
    hours, minutes = map(int, time_str.split(":"))
    return hours * 60 + minutes

def to_time(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

def is_free(busy_intervals, start, end):
    for busy_start, busy_end in busy_intervals:
        if start < busy_end and end > busy_start:
            return False
    return True

def solve():
    work_start = to_min("09:00")
    work_end = to_min("17:00")
    duration = 30

    schedules = {
        "Arthur": {
            "Monday": [("11:00", "11:30"), ("13:30", "14:00"), ("15:00", "15:30")],
            "Tuesday": [("13:00", "13:30"), ("16:00", "16:30")],
            "Wednesday": [("10:00", "10:30"), ("11:00", "11:30"), ("12:00", "12:30"), ("14:00", "14:30"), ("16:00", "16:30")]
        },
        "Michael": {
            "Monday": [("09:00", "12:00"), ("12:30", "13:00"), ("14:00", "14:30"), ("15:00", "17:00")],
            "Tuesday": [("09:30", "11:30"), ("12:00", "13:30"), ("14:00", "15:30")],
            "Wednesday": [("10:00", "12:30"), ("13:00", "13:30")]
        }
    }

    busy = {}
    for person, person_schedule in schedules.items():
        busy[person] = {}
        for day, intervals in person_schedule.items():
            busy[person][day] = [(to_min(s), to_min(e)) for s, e in intervals]

    participants = ("Arthur", "Michael")
    days = ("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday")
    unavailable_days = {"Arthur": {"Tuesday"}}

    for day in days:
        if any(day in unavailable_days.get(person, set()) for person in participants):
            continue
        for start in range(work_start, work_end - duration + 1, 30):
            end = start + duration
            if all(is_free(busy[person].get(day, []), start, end) for person in participants):
                return [day, to_time(start), to_time(end)]

    return None

def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))

def to_hhmm(total_minutes):
    return f"{total_minutes // 60:02d}:{total_minutes % 60:02d}"

def free_slots(busy, work_start, work_end):
    busy = sorted(busy)
    merged = []
    for start, end in busy:
        if not merged or start > merged[-1][1]:
            merged.append([start, end])
        else:
            merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], end)

    slots = []
    current = work_start
    for start, end in merged:
        if current < start:
            slots.append((current, start))
        current = max(current, end)
    if current < work_end:
        slots.append((current, work_end))
    return slots

def intersect(slot_lists):
    result = slot_lists[0]
    for slots in slot_lists[1:]:
        new_result = []
        for a_start, a_end in result:
            for b_start, b_end in slots:
                start = max(a_start, b_start)
                end = min(a_end, b_end)
                if start < end:
                    new_result.append((start, end))
        result = new_result
    return result

from itertools import product

WORK_START = 9*60
WORK_END = 17*60
DURATION = 60
DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"]

def to_min(hhmm):
    h, m = map(int, hhmm.split(":"))
    return h*60+m

def to_hhmm(mins):
    return f"{mins//60:02d}:{mins%60:02d}"

BUSY = {
    "Natalie": {
        "Monday": ["09:00-09:30", "10:00-12:00", "12:30-13:00", "14:00-14:30", "15:00-16:30"],
        ...
    },
    "William": {...}
}

def is_free(person, day, start, end):
    for interval in BUSY[person][day]:
        bs, be = interval.split("-")
        b_start = to_min(bs)
        b_end = to_min(be)
        if start < b_end and end > b_start:
            return False
    return True

def find_slot():
    for day in DAYS:
        for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1, 30):
            end = start + DURATION
            if all(is_free(person, day, start, end) for person in BUSY):
                return [day, to_hhmm(start), to_hhmm(end)]
    return None

print(find_slot())
```

def parse_time(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

def format_time(mins):

BUSY = {
    "Natalie": {
        "Monday": [("09:00", "09:30"), ("10:00", "12:00"), ("12:30", "13:00"), ("14:00", "14:30"), ("15:00", "16:30")],

        "Tuesday": [("09:00", "13:00"), ("13:30", "16:00")],
        "Wednesday": [("09:00", "12:30"), ("13:00", "14:30"), ("15:30", "16:00"), ("16:30", "17:00")],

    }
}

DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"]
WORK_START = 9 * 60
WORK_END = 17 * 60
DURATION = 60

def is_free(person, day, start, end):
    for busy_start, busy_end in BUSY[person][day]:
        if start < parse_time(busy_end) and end > parse_time(busy_start):
            return False
    return True

def find_slot():

        for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1, 30):
            end = start + DURATION
            if all(is_free(person, day, start, end) for person in BUSY):
                return [day, format_time(start), format_time(end)]

print(find_slot())

def to_min(hhmm):
    h, m = map(int, hhmm.split(':'))
    return h*60 + m

def fmt(minute):
    return f"{minute//60:02d}:{minute%60:02d}"

DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday"]
DURATION = 60
WORK_START = to_min("09:00")
WORK_END = to_min("17:00")

busy = {
    "Brian": {
        "Monday": [("09:30","10:00"), ...],
        ...
    },
    "Julia": {...}
}

def is_free(person, day, start, end):
    for s,e in busy[person][day]:
       bs, be = to_min(s), to_min(e)
       if start < be and end > bs:
           return False
    return True

def feasible(day, start):
    end = start + DURATION
    if start < WORK_START or end > WORK_END:
        return False
    return all(is_free(p, day, start, end) for p in ("Brian","Julia"))

solutions = []
for day in DAYS:
    for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1):
        if feasible(day, start):
            solutions.append((day, start, start + DURATION))

# Brian prefers no Monday.  Earliest availability among acceptable days.
non_monday = [s for s in solutions if s[0] != "Monday"]
if non_monday:

    day_order = {d:i for i,d in enumerate(DAYS)}
    best = min(non_monday, key=lambda s: (day_order[s[0]], s[1]))
else:
    best = min(solutions, key=lambda s: (day_order[s[0]], s[1]))

print([best[0], fmt(best[1]), fmt(best[2])])
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Meeting scheduling CSP solver.
# Variables are meeting start/end minutes; constraints are busy intervals.

WORK_START = 9 * 60
WORK_END = 17 * 60
DURATION = 30

def hm(h, minute=0):
    return h * 60 + minute

busy = {
    "Andrea": [],
    "Jack": [(hm(9), hm(9, 30)), (hm(14), hm(14, 30))],
    "Madison": [(hm(9, 30), hm(10, 30)), (hm(13), hm(14)), (hm(15), hm(15, 30)), (hm(16, 30), hm(17))],
    "Rachel": [(hm(9, 30), hm(10, 30)), (hm(11), hm(11, 30)), (hm(12), hm(13, 30)), (hm(14, 30), hm(15, 30)), (hm(16), hm(17))],
    "Douglas": [(hm(9), hm(11, 30)), (hm(12), hm(16, 30))],
    "Ryan": [(hm(9), hm(9, 30)), (hm(13), hm(14)), (hm(14, 30), hm(17))],
}

def free_intervals(busy_intervals):
    intervals = []
    current = WORK_START
    for start, end in sorted(busy_intervals):
        if start > current:
            intervals.append((current, start))
        if end > current:
            current = end
    if current < WORK_END:
        intervals.append((current, WORK_END))
    return intervals

def intersect(a, b):
    result = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
        start = max(a[i][0], b[j][0])
        end = min(a[i][1], b[j][1])
        if end - start >= DURATION:
            result.append((start, end))
        if a[i][1] < b[j][1]:
            i += 1
        elif b[j][1] < a[i][1]:
            j += 1
        else:
            i += 1
            j += 1
    return result

all_free = [free_intervals(intervals) for intervals in busy.values()]
common = all_free[0]
for intervals in all_free[1:]:
    common = intersect(common, intervals)

start, end = common[0][0], common[0][0] + DURATION
day = "Monday"
print([day, f"{start // 60:02d}:{start % 60:02d}", f"{end // 60:02d}:{end % 60:02d}"])
```

def to_minutes(hhmm: str) -> int:
    h, m = map(int, hhmm.split(":"))

WORK_START = to_minutes("09:00")

    ],
    "Angela": [],
    "Natalie": [
        (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("11:30")),
        (to_minutes("12:00"), to_minutes("13:00")),
        (to_minutes("14:00"), to_minutes("14:30")),
        (to_minutes("15:00"), to_minutes("17:00")),

}

    end = start + DURATION
    for intervals in BUSY.values():

    return True

        if is_free(start):
            return start
    raise RuntimeError("No slot found")

def overlaps(start, end, busy_intervals):
    for b_start, b_end in busy_intervals:
        if start < b_end and end > b_start:
            return True

    cheryl_busy = {

        "Tuesday": [(to_min(15,0), to_min(15,30))],
        "Wednesday": []
    }
    kyle_busy = {
        "Monday": [(to_min(9,0), to_min(17,0))],
        "Tuesday": [(to_min(9,30), to_min(17,0))],

    }
    if overlaps(start, end, cheryl_busy[day]):
        return False
    if overlaps(start, end, kyle_busy[day]):
        return False
    return True

def solve():
    for day in DAYS:
        for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - SLOT + 1, SLOT):
            if available(day, start):
                return [day, fmt(start), fmt(start + SLOT)]

print(solve())

def to_time(minutes):

def overlaps(start, end, intervals):

    return False
